title: Paul McCartney live: Reunion Arena, Dallas | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Reunion Arena in Dallas, Texas, USA, on 9 May 2002.

It was the 21st date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002, and the first of two consecutive nights in Dallas.

The performances of ‘Jet’, ‘Every Night’, ‘Band On The Run’, ‘Back In The USSR’, ‘My Love’, ‘Live And Let Die’, and ‘Yesterday’ from this show appear on the 2002 live albums Back In The US and Back In The World. The recording of ‘Freedom’ also appears on Back In The US.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
